name: UNIQUE_ID
description: Unique record code generated by system. Primary Key.

name: COLLISION_ID
description: Crash identification code. Foreign Key, matches unique_id from the Crash table.

name: CRASH_DATE
description: Occurrence date of collision

name: CRASH_TIME
description: Occurrence time of collision

name: VEHICLE_ID
description: Vehicle identification code assigned by system

name: STATE_REGISTRATION
description: State where vehicle is registered.

name: VEHICLE_TYPE
description: Type of vehicle based on the selected vehicle category (ATV, bicycle, car/suv, ebike, escooter, truck/bus, motorcycle, other)

name: VEHICLE_MAKE
description: Vehicle make

name: VEHICLE_MODEL
description: Vehicle model

name: VEHICLE_YEAR
description: Year the vehicle was manufactured

name: TRAVEL_DIRECTION
description: Direction vehicle was traveling

name: VEHICLE_OCCUPANTS
description: Number of vehicle occupants

name: DRIVER_SEX
description: Gender of driver

name: DRIVER_LICENSE_STATUS
description: License, permit, unlicensed

name: DRIVER_LICENSE_JURISDICTION
description: State where driver license was issued.

name: PRE_CRASH
description: Pre-crash action: Going straight, making right turn, passing, backing, etc.

name: POINT_OF_IMPACT
description: Location on the vehicle of the initial point of impact (i.e. driver side, passenger side rear, etc.)

name: VEHICLE_DAMAGE
description: Location on the vehicle where most of the damage occurred

name: VEHICLE_DAMAGE_1
description: Additional damage locations on the vehicle

name: VEHICLE_DAMAGE_2
description: Additional damage locations on the vehicle

name: VEHICLE_DAMAGE_3
description: Additional damage locations on the vehicle

name: PUBLIC_PROPERTY_DAMAGE
description: Public property damaged (Yes or No)

name: PUBLIC_PROPERTY_DAMAGE_TYPE
description: Type of public property damaged (ex. Sign, fence, light post, etc.)

name: CONTRIBUTING_FACTOR_1
description: Factors contributing to the collision for designated vehicle

name: CONTRIBUTING_FACTOR_2
description: Factors contributing to the collision for designated vehicle
